questions.stem: Which environmental problem is most associated with addition polymers?

options.text: They dissolve in water and poison fish
They react with oxygen in the air causing smog
They release toxic gases at room temperature
They are non-biodegradable and persist in the environment

questions.explanation: Addition polymers like poly(ethene) and PVC are non-biodegradable because they have no functional groups that natural enzymes can break down. They only have strong C-C single bonds in the chain. This means they persist in landfill and the environment for hundreds of years, causing pollution.
